value="<b>control</b> — Spring Boot<br><font style="font-size:11px;">REST API · publishes immutable releases · Aeron client for operator commands · watches discovery + L3 · scheduler<br><br><i>Reference data is validated by constructing the real</i> reference <i>domain types — the fingerprint is never reimplemented.<br>Each scheduler tick reconciles the phase the parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#666666;dashed=1;fontSize=13;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="<b>Published release</b> · releases/000007/ — immutable, never rewritten<br><font style="font-size:11px;">shard-N-securities.properties · discovery.properties · manifest.json (fingerprint per shard)<br><i>This file, not the database, is what every process boots from.</i></font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="112" width="800" x="1740" y="512" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="disc" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFE6CC;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontSize=14;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontColor=#7A4F00;" value="<b>discovery</b><br><br><font style="font-size:11px;">Broadcasts the tradable universe on a repeating cycle — no request protocol, so a restarted adapter recovers on its own.<br><br>Publishes the <b>gateway's</b> client endpoints, not the cluster's: an adapter that connected to the cluster would bypass validation and cumQty reconstruction.<br><br>239.10.0.1:40000 · stream 100</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="560" x="1510" y="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="notes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFDE7;strokeColor=#D6B656;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;fontSize=11;fontColor=#4A4A4A;" value="<b>Invariants this shape encodes</b><br><br>• A node is <b>two processes</b>. The driver allocates, so it stays out of the engine.<br><br>• The engine never calls a clock. Time is the sequenced consensus timestamp.<br><br>• Book events and egress are <b>leader-only</b>; the book event stream is muted on followers via onRoleChange.<br><br>• Operator commands take the <b>same path as an order</b> and are sequenced through the log — there is no control channel.<br><br>• Commands are <b>unacknowledged</b>. SessionChanged on L3 confirms a phase; nothing confirms a SecurityDefinition.<br><br>• A halt is visible <b>only on L3</b>, and recovery is operator-driven." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" div.div:
Invariants this shape encodes
• A node is two processes. The driver allocates, so it stays out of the engine.
• The engine never calls a clock. Time is the sequenced consensus timestamp.
• Book events and egress are leader-only; the book event stream is muted on followers via onRoleChange.
• Operator commands take the same path as an order and are sequenced through the log — there is no control channel.
• Commands are unacknowledged. SessionChanged on L3 confirms a phase; nothing confirms a SecurityDefinition.
• A halt is visible only on L3, and recovery is operator-driven.
